title: Drift — a little story, together
status: Reviewable submission video draft; not uploaded or submitted

scenes.title: A little story, together.
scenes.body: Six words from you. Six from someone else.
scenes.note: A daily bottle ritual, inspired by QQ and WeChat.
scenes.caption: Drift revives QQ and WeChat drift bottles as a tiny shared story: one six-word beginning and one six-word ending.
Local sandbox recording, AI checks off, synthetic guest identities. Catch a beginning, unfold the note over the sea, write six words, save the shared postcard, then optionally pass on a beginning.

scenes.kicker: SECOND GUEST IDENTITY / SAME RECORDED RUN
scenes.title: Meanwhile, on the other shore.
scenes.note: Jump cut to the original writer · local sandbox, AI off
scenes.caption: We now switch to the original writer in the same recorded run. Idle waiting has been cut.
The original writer opens the same canonical postcard from their collection without refreshing. Local sandbox, AI checks off, synthetic writers.

scenes.title: One catch. One shared result.
scenes.body: Exclusive, expiring claims. Transactional completion. Live subscriptions.
scenes.note: Ten-writer network checks passed after fixing simultaneous ID collisions.
scenes.caption: SpacetimeDB holds the exclusive catch, validates completion and returns the canonical postcard to both writers through live subscriptions. Ten-writer network checks passed after an ID-collision fix.

scenes.kicker: SEPARATE HOSTED TEST / REAL CLAUDE CALLS
scenes.title: AI supports the people writing.
paragraphs: Haiku checks the beginning and the combined story. Optional Sonnet guidance suggests an angle.
This actual hosted postcard used synthetic test writers. Both creative halves were supplied through the test UI.
35 of 36 synthetic moderation labels matched in the development evaluation.
scenes.note: Agent-reviewed evidence; no independent moderation study or attendee pilot.
scenes.caption: Separate hosted evidence: this real postcard passed Claude checks. Haiku checks content; Sonnet can suggest an angle without filling the ending. The development moderation evaluation matched 35 of 36 synthetic labels, with agent review.

scenes.kicker: FIGMA MAKE / INSPECT, REVISE, HAND OFF
scenes.title: An empty sea can still invite you in.
paragraphs: A late-stage Make prototype explored the quiet pool and returned-story states.
The first empty state was too tall and opaque. A second prompt made the paper compact and the next action clear.
That design decision reached the real game in commit 2544990.
scenes.note: Actual prototype screenshot · sample content · separate from the live game
scenes.caption: Figma Make helped refine the quiet pool and returned-story states. We inspected the first prototype, revised its oversized paper, and implemented the selected design decision in the game.

scenes.title: A playable handoff.
paragraphs: Eight native Slides pages include the stage log, working-code links and a playable Make embed.
The embedded empty-state control was exercised inside the actual presentation.
scenes.note: Make and Slides sharing: Anyone can view. Minutes and ratings are agent estimates.
scenes.caption: The native eight-page Figma Slides deck includes the four-stage log, code links and a Make embed that we exercised inside the presentation. Both Figma files allow link viewing.

scenes.title: Help the team prepare. Keep the words human.
paragraphs: Bottle Kitchen runs inside Mana: seven themes, six-word validation, review progress and JSON export.
It stores this visitor's drafts locally and makes no calls to the live Drift database.
scenes.note: Actual app screenshot · human starter inventory remains empty
scenes.caption: Mana built Bottle Kitchen, a working preparation app with seven themes, six-word validation, review progress and JSON export. It keeps drafts in the visitor's browser; human starter inventory is still empty.

scenes.kicker: MANA → DRIFT / AN ACTUAL CONTENT HANDOFF
scenes.title: A draft must stay a draft.
paragraphs: Production export requires twenty valid, unique, reviewed lines per theme and an explicit team attestation.
Our actual synthetic draft downloaded from Mana passed Drift's structural validator and was refused for production installation.
scenes.note: The tool cannot verify authorship. Human review and moderation remain necessary.
scenes.caption: Production export stays locked until all seven themes have twenty reviewed lines and the team attests authorship. We downloaded a real synthetic draft: Drift accepted its structure and refused production installation.

scenes.kicker: OPEN THE SHORE. LEAVE SIX WORDS.
scenes.title: A small moment of together.
scenes.note: Real-phone checks and human pilot still ahead. Source repo remains private.
scenes.caption: Try the deployed Drift game. Real-phone checks, independent moderation review and a human pilot remain. The private source repository still needs judge access.
